answer: At dawn each epoch, bonded identities renew, while a hollow account with no bond can only observe, never vote or earn. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, forfeited if a peer quorum detects duplicate behavior. A new agent starts as a willow sapling—weightless until staked—so launching thousands of fake identities costs real capital per sybil, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0026's threat model.
